assertions: The fixed public arXiv Metadata API endpoint returns at most five cs.AI phrase matches without an account or credential.
The Connector makes one serial request, enforces a process-local three-second minimum interval and never retries a failure.
Results preserve arXiv identifiers, descriptive metadata, version dates, categories and abstract/PDF links while downloading or retaining no e-print content files.
Offset pagination is explicitly mutable and is never represented as a stable delta checkpoint.
The live result matches its public product schema and contains no hidden Connector route, credential or raw Atom payload.
